duas.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ.
duas.transliteration: Asbahnaa wa asbahal-mulku lillaah, walhamdu lillaah, laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer. Rabbi as'aluka khayra maa fee haadhal-yawmi wa khayra maa ba'dahu, wa a'oodhu bika min sharri maa fee haadhal-yawmi wa sharri maa ba'dah, Rabbi a'oodhu bika minal-kasali wa soo'il-kibar, Rabbi a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabin fin-naari wa 'adhaabin fil-qabr.
duas.swahili: Tumeingia asubuhi na ufalme wote umebaki kuwa wa Mwenyezi Mungu, na sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu. Hapana mola apasaye kuabudiwa kwa haki ila Mwenyezi Mungu Mmoja pekee, hana mshirika, ufalme wote ni Wake na sifa zote njema ni Zake, Naye juu ya kila kitu ni Muweza. Mola wangu, nakuomba kheri ya siku hii ya leo na kheri ya baada yake, na ninajikinga Kwako na shari ya siku hii ya leo na shari ya baada yake. Mola wangu, ninajikinga Kwako kutokana na uvivu na ubaya wa uzee. Mola wangu, ninajikinga Kwako na adhabu ya Moto na adhabu ya kaburi.
duas.english: We have entered the morning and at this very time the whole kingdom belongs to Allah, praise is due to Allah. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
duas.virtue_sw: Hukukinga na shari za mchana mzima na kukuweka chini ya uangalizi wa Mwenyezi Mungu.
duas.virtue_en: Protects against the evils of the day and grants Allah's guardianship.

duas.title_sw: Sayyidul Istighfar (Bwana wa Maombi ya Msamaha)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma Anta Rabbiy laa ilaaha illaa Ant, khalaqtanee wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'alaa 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'oodhu bika min sharri maa sana't, aboo'u laka bini'matika 'alayy, wa aboo'u bidhambee faghfir lee fa-innahu laa yaghfirudh-dhunooba illaa Ant.
duas.swahili: Ee Mwenyezi Mungu, Wewe ndiye Mola wangu, hapana mola apasaye kuabudiwa kwa haki ila Wewe. Umeniumba mimi na mimi ni mja Wako, nami niko juu ya ahadi Yako na agano Lako kadiri niwezavyo. Ninajikinga Kwako na shari ya yale niliyoyafanya. Ninakiri Kwako neema Zako zilizo juu yangu, na ninakiri Kwako madhambi yangu, basi ninasamehe, kwani hakika hakuna anayesamehe madhambi ila Wewe.
duas.english: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide by Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge before You Your blessings upon me, and I confess to You my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ amesema: 'Mwenye kuisoma mchana akiwa na yakini nayo kisha akafa siku hiyo kabla ya jioni, basi ni miongoni mwa watu wa Peponi.'
duas.virtue_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Whoever says it during the day with firm conviction and dies that day before evening, will be from the people of Paradise.'

duas.title_sw: Ulinzi Kutokana na Kila Kitu (Bismillahi Alladhi)
duas.title_en: Protection In the Name of Allah
duas.title_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahil-ladhee laa yadurru ma'as-mihi shay'un fil-ardi wa laa fis-samaa'i wa Huwas-Samee'ul-'Aleem.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye hakidhuru chochote kile pamoja na jina Lake, si katika ardhi wala mbinguni, Naye ndiye Mwenye kusikia yote, Mwenye kujua kila kitu.
duas.english: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuisoma mara 3 asubuhi na mara 3 jioni, hakuna chochote kitakachomdhuru.
duas.virtue_en: Whoever recites it three times in the morning and evening, nothing will harm them.

duas.title_en: Pleased with Allah as my Lord
duas.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبّاً، وَبِالإِسْلاَمِ دِيناً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيّاً.
duas.transliteration: Radeetu billaahi Rabban, wa bil-Islaami deenan, wa bi-Muhammadin sallallaahu 'alayhi wa sallama Nabiyyaa.
duas.swahili: Nimeridhika na Mwenyezi Mungu kuwa ndiye Mola wangu, na Uislamu kuwa ndiyo dini yangu, na Muhammad ﷺ kuwa ndiye Nabii wangu.
duas.english: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad ﷺ as my Prophet.
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuisoma mara 3 asubuhi na jioni, ni haki juu ya Mwenyezi Mungu kumridhisha siku ya Kiyama.
duas.virtue_en: Whoever recites it three times morning and evening, it is a duty upon Allah to please him on the Day of Resurrection.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Uhai na Ulinzi (Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyoom)
duas.title_ar: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
duas.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ.
duas.transliteration: Yaa Hayyu yaa Qayyoomu birahmatika astagheeth, aslih lee sha'nee kullah, wa laa takilnee ilaa nafsee tarfata 'ayn.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenye kuwa hai milele, Ewe Msimamia mambo yote! Kwa rehema Yako ninaomba msaada; nitengenezee mambo yangu yote, wala usiniachie nafsi yangu hata kwa kope ya jicho.
duas.english: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, in Your mercy I seek relief. Correct for me all my affairs and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
duas.virtue_sw: Huleta utulivu wa moyo na kumuweka mwanadamu chini ya usimamizi wa Mwenyezi Mungu moja kwa moja.
duas.virtue_en: Brings heart tranquility and places the servant under Allah's constant care.

duas.title_en: Glory and Praise to Allah 100 times
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanallaahi wa bihamdih.
duas.swahili: Kutakasika ni kwa Mwenyezi Mungu na sifa zote njema ni Zake.
duas.english: Glory is to Allah and all praise is to Him.
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuisoma mara 100 asubuhi na jioni, atafutiwa madhambi yake hata yakiwa kama povu la bahari, na hapatakuwa na yeyote atakayekuja na amali bora zaidi siku ya Kiyama.
duas.virtue_en: Whoever says it 100 times morning and evening, his sins will be erased even if like the foam of the sea.

duas.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ.
duas.transliteration: Amsaynaa wa amsal-mulku lillaah, walhamdu lillaah, laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer. Rabbi as'aluka khayra maa fee haadhihil-laylati wa khayra maa ba'dahaa, wa a'oodhu bika min sharri maa fee haadhihil-laylati wa sharri maa ba'dahaa, Rabbi a'oodhu bika minal-kasali wa soo'il-kibar, Rabbi a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabin fin-naari wa 'adhaabin fil-qabr.
duas.swahili: Tumeingia jioni na ufalme wote umebaki kuwa wa Mwenyezi Mungu, na sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu. Hapana mola apasaye kuabudiwa kwa haki ila Mwenyezi Mungu Mmoja pekee, hana mshirika, ufalme wote ni Wake na sifa zote njema ni Zake, Naye juu ya kila kitu ni Muweza. Mola wangu, nakuomba kheri ya usiku huu na kheri ya baada yake, na ninajikinga Kwako na shari ya usiku huu na shari ya baada yake.
duas.english: We have reached the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner.
duas.virtue_sw: Hukukinga na shari zote za usiku na kuleta amani na utulivu.
duas.virtue_en: Protects against all nighttime evils and grants tranquility.

duas.title_sw: Kujikinga na Viumbe Wenye Sumu na Shari
duas.title_en: Seeking Refuge with Allah's Perfect Words
duas.title_ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ.
duas.transliteration: A'oodhu bikalimaatil-laahit-taammaati min sharri maa khalaq.
duas.swahili: Ninajikinga kwa maneno ya Mwenyezi Mungu yaliyokamilika kutokana na shari ya vile Alivyoviumba.
duas.english: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuisoma mara 3 jioni, hawezi kudhuriwa na mdudu mwenye sumu wala kiumbe chochote chenye shari usiku huo.
duas.virtue_en: Whoever recites it three times in the evening, no poisonous creature or harm will touch him that night.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kulala (Kwa Jina Lako Mola Wangu)
duas.title_en: In Your Name My Lord I Lie Down
duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ.
duas.transliteration: Bismika Rabbee wada'tu jambee, wa bika arfa'uh, fa-in amsakta nafsee farhamhaa, wa in arsaltahaa fahfadh-haa bimaa tahfadhu bihi 'ibaadakas-saaliheen.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina Lako Mola wangu ninaweka ubavu wangu, na kwa ajili Yako ninaunyanyua. Ukiizuia roho yangu (nikafa usingizini) basi irehemu, na ukiirudisha basi ihifadhi kama unavyowahifadhi waja Wako wema.
duas.english: In Your name my Lord, I lie down and in Your name I arise, so if You should take my soul then have mercy upon it, and if You should return my soul then protect it in the manner You do with Your righteous servants.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #101, Sahih al-Bukhari 6320, Sahih Muslim 2714
duas.virtue_sw: Hukupa usingizi mzuri wenye amani na ulinzi wa Malaika hadi unapoamka.
duas.virtue_en: Grants peaceful sleep under angels' protection until morning.

duas.title_ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ.
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee ahyaanaa ba'da maa amaatanaa wa ilayhin-nushoor.
duas.swahili: Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye ametuhuisha baada ya kutufisha (kwa usingizi), na Kwake ndiyo marejeo na kufufuliwa.
duas.english: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us, and unto Him is the resurrection.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #1, Sahih al-Bukhari 6312, Sahih Muslim 2711
duas.virtue_sw: Hufungua vifungo vya Shetani vilivyofungwa wakati wa kulala na kumpa mtu bashasha na wepesi wa asubuhi.
duas.virtue_en: Unties Satan's knots and grants an energetic, blessed start to the morning.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummaf-tah lee abwaaba rahmatik.
duas.swahili: Ee Mwenyezi Mungu, nifungulie milango ya rehema Yako.
duas.english: O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me.
duas.virtue_sw: Huingia katika nyumba ya Mwenyezi Mungu akizungukwa na rehema na utulivu.
duas.virtue_en: Invites Allah's mercy and tranquility upon entering His house.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka min fadlik.
duas.swahili: Ee Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi nakuomba katika fadhila Zako.
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty.
duas.virtue_sw: Hutoka akielekea kwenye riziki na baraka Zake za halali.
duas.virtue_en: Seeks lawful provisions and divine bounty upon departure.

duas.title_sw: Dua Baada ya Kutoa Salamu Katika Swala
duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ (ثَلاَثاً)، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ.
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullaah (mara 3). Allaahumma Antas-Salaamu wa minkas-salaamu, tabaarakta yaa Dhal-Jalaali wal-Ikraam.
duas.swahili: Ninamuomba Mwenyezi Mungu msamaha (mara 3). Ee Mwenyezi Mungu, Wewe ndiye Amani, na kutoka Kwako ndiko kunakotoka amani. Umebarikika Ewe Mwenye Utukufu na Ukarimu.
duas.english: I ask Allah for forgiveness (three times). O Allah, You are As-Salam and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Owner of Majesty and Honor.
duas.virtue_sw: Sunnah inayopendekezwa kusomwa mara moja baada ya kumaliza swala ya faradhi.
duas.virtue_en: Beloved Sunnah to be recited immediately upon finishing obligatory prayers.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Nabii Yunus Wakati wa Shida (Dhun-Noon)
duas.title_ar: دُعَاءُ ذِي النُّونِ فِي بَطْنِ الْحُوتِ
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ.
duas.transliteration: Laa ilaaha illaa Anta subhaanaka innee kuntu minadh-dhaalimeen.
duas.swahili: Hapana mola apasaye kuabudiwa kwa haki ila Wewe, kutakasika ni Kwako; hakika mimi nilikuwa miongoni mwa waliodhulumu nafsi zao.
duas.english: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ amesema: 'Muislamu yeyote atakayemuomba Mola wake kwa dua hii katika jambo lolote lile, basi Mwenyezi Mungu atamjibu na kumuondolea shida hiyo.'
duas.virtue_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'No Muslim suppliant ever prays with these words for anything, but Allah will answer him.'

duas.title_en: Supplication Against Worry, Grief and Debt
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijaal.
duas.swahili: Ee Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi ninajikinga Kwako kutokana na hamu na huzuni, na kutoweza na uvivu, na ubakhili na uoga, na kuelemewa na madeni na kudhulumiwa au kushindwa na watu.
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from grief and sadness, from weakness and from laziness, from miserliness and from cowardice, from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men.
duas.virtue_sw: Humuondolea muislamu msongo wa mawazo, uzito wa madeni na kumpa nguvu ya kupambana na maisha.
duas.virtue_en: Relieves anxiety, heavy debts, and restores emotional and spiritual strength.

duas.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ.
duas.transliteration: Hasbunallaahu wa ni'mal-wakeel.
duas.swahili: Mwenyezi Mungu anatutosha, Naye ndiye Msimamizi bora zaidi.
duas.english: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #126, Sahih al-Bukhari 4563, Surat Aal-Imran 3:173
duas.virtue_sw: Dua aliyoisoma Nabii Ibrahim alipotupwa motoni, na aliyoisoma Nabii Muhammad ﷺ pale maadui walipokusanyika dhidi yake.
duas.virtue_en: The supplication of Prophet Ibrahim when cast into fire, and Prophet Muhammad ﷺ against enemies.

duas.title_sw: Istighfar ya Kila Siku (Astaghfirullah wa Atoobu Ilayh)
duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ.
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullaaha wa atoobu ilayh.
duas.swahili: Ninamuomba Mwenyezi Mungu msamaha na ninatubu Kwake.
duas.english: I seek forgiveness from Allah and I repent unto Him.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #261, Sahih al-Bukhari 6307, Sahih Muslim 2702
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ alikuwa akiomba msamaha na kutubu kwa Mwenyezi Mungu zaidi ya mara 70 hadi 100 kwa siku.
duas.virtue_en: The Prophet ﷺ used to seek forgiveness and repent more than 70 to 100 times daily.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahi tawakkaltu 'alallaahi, wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu, nimemtegemea Mwenyezi Mungu, wala hapana uwezo wala nguvu ila kwa msaada wa Mwenyezi Mungu.
duas.english: In the name of Allah, I have placed my trust in Allah; there is no power and no might except by Allah.
duas.virtue_sw: Malaika humwambia msomaji: 'Umeongozwa, umetoshelezwa na umekingwa,' na Shetani hujitenga naye mbali.
duas.virtue_en: It is said to him: 'You are guided, defended and protected,' and Satan withdraws from him.

duas.title_en: Supplication for Travel and Mounting a Vehicle
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanal-ladhee sakh-khara lanaa haadhaa wa maa kunnaa lahu muqrineen, wa innaa ilaa Rabbinaa lamunqaliboon.
duas.swahili: Ametakasika Yule aliyetutiishia sisi chombo hiki, nasi tusingaliweza kukidhibiti wenyewe, na hakika sisi ni wenye kurejea kwa Mola wetu.
duas.english: Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could never have it by our efforts. And indeed, to our Lord we will return.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #206, Sahih Muslim 1342, Surat Az-Zukhruf 43:13-14
duas.virtue_sw: Humkinga msafiri kutokana na ajali, machungu ya safari na majanga njiani.
duas.virtue_en: Protects travelers from mishaps, road hardships, and difficulties.

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا، وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ.
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee at'amanee haadhaa, wa razaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wa laa quwwah.
duas.swahili: Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye amenilisha chakula hiki na kuniruzuku bila uwezo wala nguvu kutoka kwangu.
duas.english: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might or power on my part.
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuisoma baada ya kula husamehewa madhambi yake yaliyopita.
duas.virtue_en: Whoever says it after eating, his past sins will be forgiven.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaah, Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-khubuthi wal-khabaa'ith.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi ninajikinga Kwako na mashetani wa kiume na wa kike.
duas.english: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge with You from all offensive and wicked evil things (male and female devils).
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #10, Sahih al-Bukhari 142, Sahih Muslim 375
duas.virtue_sw: Humkinga mtu dhidi ya madhara ya majini na mashetani wanapokuwa chooni.
duas.virtue_en: Protects against evil spirits and harms when entering the restroom.

duas.arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ.
duas.transliteration: Ghufraanaka.
duas.swahili: Nakuomba msamaha Wako (Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu).
duas.english: I seek Your forgiveness.
duas.virtue_sw: Kumuomba Mwenyezi Mungu msamaha kwa kutomdhukuru wakati uliokuwa chooni.
duas.virtue_en: Seeking Allah's forgiveness for having been in a state where remembrance was paused.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaah.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu.
duas.english: In the name of Allah.
duas.virtue_sw: Inaleta baraka kwenye chakula na kumzuia shetani asishiriki chakula chako.
duas.virtue_en: Brings barakah to the food and prevents devil from partaking in it.

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ.
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee kasaanee haadhath-thawba wa razaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wa laa quwwah.
duas.swahili: Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye amenivika vazi hili na kuniruzuku bila uwezo wala nguvu kutoka kwangu.
duas.english: All praise is for Allah Who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me without any power or might from myself.
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuisoma anasamehewa madhambi yake yaliyotangulia.
duas.virtue_en: Whoever recites it has their previous minor sins forgiven.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahi walajnaa, wa bismillaahi kharajnaa, wa 'alaa Rabbinaa tawakkalnaa.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu tunaingia, na kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu tulitoka, na kwa Mola wetu Mlezi tunamtegemea.
duas.english: In the name of Allah we enter, and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we rely.
duas.virtue_sw: Hufukuza shetani asilale wala kula kwenye nyumba yako.
duas.virtue_en: Bars the devil from shelter and food in the household.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma kamaa hassanta khalqee fahassin khuluqee.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, kama Ulivyoufanya mzuri umbo langu, basi ufanye mzuri na tabia yangu.
duas.english: O Allah, just as You have made my physical appearance good, make my character and manners good.
duas.virtue_sw: Kumuomba Mwenyezi Mungu akhlaaq njema na uzuri wa ndani sambamba na uzuri wa nje.
duas.virtue_en: Supplication for beautiful character and high moral conduct.

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanakallaahumma wa bihamdika, ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illaa Anta, astaghfiruka wa atoobu ilayk.
duas.swahili: Kutakasika ni Kwako Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu na sifa njema zote ni Zako, nashuhudia kwamba hapana mola apasaye kuabudiwa kwa haki ila Wewe, nakuomba msamaha na ninatubu Kwako.
duas.english: Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise. I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.
duas.virtue_sw: Hufuta maneno yasiyofaa na makosa yaliyotokea ndani ya kikao hicho.
duas.virtue_en: Expiates any idle talk, shortcomings or sins that occurred in the gathering.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma sayyiban naafi'aa.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, iweke iwe mvua yenye manufaa na kheri.
duas.english: O Allah, may it be a beneficial rain.
duas.virtue_sw: Mvua inaponyesha ni miongoni mwa nyakati ambazo dua hujibiwa haraka na Mwenyezi Mungu.
duas.virtue_en: Rain is a special time of acceptance of prayers, asking for beneficial rain without destruction.

duas.arabic: مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ.
duas.transliteration: Mutirnaa bifadhlillaahi wa rahmatih.
duas.swahili: Tumenyeshewa mvua kwa fadhila za Mwenyezi Mungu na rehema Zake.
duas.english: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #168, Sahih al-Bukhari 846, Sahih Muslim 71
duas.virtue_sw: Kukiri na kushukuru kwamba mvua inatoka kwa Mwenyezi Mungu na si kutokana na nyota au miujiza mingine.
duas.virtue_en: Affirming Tawhid and recognizing Allah alone as the sender of rain.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaah.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu.
duas.english: In the name of Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #12, Abu Dawud 101, Ibn Majah 399
duas.virtue_sw: Hakuna wudhu kamili kwa yule asiyetaja jina la Mwenyezi Mungu kabla ya kuanza.
duas.virtue_en: Commencing wudu with the name of Allah completes and blesses the purification.

duas.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ. اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ.
duas.transliteration: Ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa Rasooluh. Allaahummaj'alnee minat-tawwaabeena waj'alnee minal-mutatahhireen.
duas.swahili: Nashuhudia kwamba hapana mola apasaye kuabudiwa kwa haki ila Mwenyezi Mungu Mmoja pekee hana mshirika, na nashuhudia kwamba Muhammad ni mja Wake na Mtume Wake. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nijaalie niwe miongoni mwa wanaotubu na unijaalie niwe miongoni mwa wanaojitakasa.
duas.english: I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger. O Allah, make me of the repentant and make me of the purified.
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuisoma hufunguliwa milango minane ya Pepo aingie kwa ule anaotaka.
duas.virtue_en: All eight gates of Paradise are opened for the one who recites it, to enter through whichever they wish.

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanakallaahumma wa bihamdika, wa tabaarakasmuka, wa ta'aalaa jadduka, wa laa ilaaha ghayruk.
duas.swahili: Kutakasika ni Kwako Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu na sifa njema zote ni Zako, limetukuka Jina Lako, na umetukuka utukufu Wako, na hapana mola mwingine apasaye kuabudiwa asiyekuwa Wewe.
duas.english: Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise; blessed is Your Name and exalted is Your Majesty, and there is no deity worthy of worship besides You.
duas.virtue_sw: Inasomwa kwa siri mara baada ya Takbiratul Ihram kabla ya kuanza kusoma Surat Al-Fatiha.
duas.virtue_en: Recited quietly after the initial Takbir before reciting Surah Al-Fatihah.

duas.title_sw: Dua Wakati wa Kusujudu Katika Swala
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الأَعْلَى.
duas.transliteration: Subhaana Rabbiyal-A'laa.
duas.swahili: Ametakasika Mola wangu Mlezi Aliye Juu kabisa.
duas.english: Glory is to my Lord, the Most High.
duas.virtue_sw: Mja huwa karibu zaidi na Mola wake wakati akiwa amesujudu; inashauriwa kurudia mara tatu au zaidi.
duas.virtue_en: The servant is nearest to his Lord when in prostration; recommended 3 or more times.

duas.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ، وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ.
duas.transliteration: Dhahabadh-dhama'u, wabtallatil-'urooqu, wa thabatal-ajru in shaa'Allaah.
duas.swahili: Kiu kimeondoka, na mishipa imelowa maji, na ujira umethibiti akipenda Mwenyezi Mungu.
duas.english: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
duas.virtue_sw: Inasomwa papo hapo unapofungua funga; dua ya mfungaji wakati wa kufuturu hairejeshwi.
duas.virtue_en: Recited when breaking fast; the supplication of the fasting person is readily accepted.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Sala ya Istikharah (Kutafuta Mwongozo)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلاَ أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلاَ أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلاَّمُ الْغُيُوبِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee astakheeruka bi'ilmika, wa astaqdiruka biqudratika, wa as'aluka min fadhlikal-'Adheem, fa'innaka taqdiru wa laa aqdir, wa ta'lamu wa laa a'lam, wa Anta 'Allaamul-ghuyoob.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nakuomba unichagulie kwa ilimu Yako, na nakuomba uniwezeshe kwa uwezo Wako, na nakuomba katika fadhila Zako kuu, kwani Wewe Unaweza nami siwezi, na Wewe Unajua nami sijui, na Wewe ni Mjuzi wa yaliyofichika.
duas.english: O Allah, I seek Your counsel through Your knowledge, and I seek ability through Your power, and I ask of Your great favor. For You are capable and I am not, and You know and I do not, and You are the Knower of the unseen.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ aliwafundisha masahaba kusali rakaa mbili na kusoma dua hii wakati wowote mtu anapokusudia kufanya uamuzi au jambo muhimu maishani.
duas.virtue_en: Sunnah for making decisions, seeking divine guidance in all worldly and religious matters.

duas.arabic: لاَ بَأْسَ، طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ.
duas.transliteration: Laa ba'sa, tahoorun in shaa'Allaah.
duas.swahili: Hapana neno, ni kutakasika (kwa madhambi) Mwenyezi Mungu akipenda.
duas.english: Do not worry, it is a purification, if Allah wills.
duas.virtue_sw: Inaleta matumaini, faraja na uponyaji wa kisaikolojia kwa mgonjwa, ikimkumbusha kuwa maradhi ni kafara ya madhambi.
duas.virtue_en: Comforts the ill person, reassuring that illness purifies one from sins.

duas.title_ar: دعاء من أحس بوجع في جسده
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ (mara 3)، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ (mara 7).
duas.transliteration: Bismillaah (mara 3). A'oodhu billaahi wa qudratihi min sharri maa ajidu wa uhaadhir (mara 7).
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu (mara 3). Ninajikinga kwa Mwenyezi Mungu na kwa uwezo Wake kutokana na shari ya ninachokihisi na ninachokiogopa (mara 7).
duas.english: In the name of Allah (3 times). I seek refuge with Allah and His power from the evil that I feel and fear (7 times).
duas.virtue_sw: Weka mkono wako kwenye sehemu inayouma ya mwili wako na useme Bismillah mara 3, kisha usome dua hii mara 7 kwa imani kamili ya kuponywa.
duas.virtue_en: Place your hand on the spot that hurts and recite with firm faith for physical healing.

duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ.
duas.transliteration: A'oodhu billaahi minash-shaytaanir-rajeem.
duas.swahili: Ninajikinga kwa Mwenyezi Mungu kutokana na shetani aliyetupwa mbali na rehema Yake.
duas.english: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #137, Sahih al-Bukhari 6115, Sahih Muslim 2610
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ alisema: Najua neno ambalo mtu akilisema hasira zake zitaondoka, nalo ni: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem.
duas.virtue_en: Extinguishes rage and suppresses the whisperings of Satan during anger.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا.
duas.transliteration: Rabbir-hamhumaa kamaa rabbayaanee sagheeraa.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Warehemu wazazi wangu wawili kama walivyonilea nikiwa mtoto mdogo.
duas.english: My Lord! Be merciful to them as they raised me when I was small.
duas.virtue_sw: Ni wajibu na utiifu mkuu kwa wazazi wakiwa hai na hata baada ya kifo chao; daraja ya wazazi huinuliwa Peponi kwa istighfar ya mtoto wao.
duas.virtue_en: The highest form of filial piety; raises the ranks of parents in Paradise.

duas.title_en: To Someone Who Does You a Favor
duas.arabic: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا.
duas.transliteration: Jazaakallaahu khayraa.
duas.swahili: Mwenyezi Mungu akulipe kila la kheri.
duas.english: May Allah reward you with goodness.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ alisema: Mwenye kufanyiwa wema akasema 'Jazakallahu khayran' basi amemfikishia mwenziwe kiwango cha juu kabisa cha sifa na shukrani.
duas.virtue_en: The most sublime and complete expression of gratitude in Islam.

duas.title_sw: Ayat al-Kursi (Aya ya Enzi - Kinga Kuu)
duas.title_en: Ayat al-Kursi (The Verse of the Throne)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoom, laa ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa laa nawm, lahu maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardh, man dhal-ladhee yashfa'u 'indahu illaa bi'idhnih, ya'lamu maa bayna aydeehim wa maa khalfahum, wa laa yuheetoona bishay'im-min 'ilmihee illaa bimaa shaa', wasi'a Kursiyyuhus-samaawaati wal-ardh, wa laa ya'ooduhu hifdhuhumaa, wa Huwal-'Aliyyul-'Adheem.
duas.swahili: Mwenyezi Mungu! Hapana mungu ila Yeye, Aliye Hai daima, Msimamia kila kitu. Hasinzii wala halali. Ni vyake vyote vilivyomo mbinguni na vilivyomo ardhini. Ni nani huyo awezaye kuombea mbele Yake bila ya idhini Yake? Anajua yaliyo mbele yao na yaliyo nyuma yao; wala hawazunguki chochote katika ilimu Yake ila kwa kile Alipendacho. Enzi Yake imetanda mbinguni na ardhini, wala halimshindi kuzilinda zote mbili. Naye ndiye Aliye Juu, Mkubwa kabisa.
duas.english: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth...
duas.reference: Surat Al-Baqarah 2:255, Hisn al-Muslim #78, Sahih al-Bukhari 2311
duas.virtue_sw: Aya kuu kuliko zote katika Qur'ani Tukufu. Mwenye kuisoma asubuhi au jioni anabaki katika ulinzi wa Mwenyezi Mungu, na shetani hamkaribii.
duas.virtue_en: The greatest verse in the Quran. Reciting it morning and evening grants divine protection from all evil.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kupanda Chombo cha Usafiri
duas.title_en: When Mounting or Boarding a Vehicle
duas.title_ar: دعاء ركوب الدابة أو وسيلة السفر
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaah, Alhamdu lillaah, Subhaanal-ladhee sakh-khara lanaa haadhaa wa maa kunnaa lahoo muqrineen, wa innaa ilaa Rabbinaa lamunqaliboon.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu, sifa njema ni za Mwenyezi Mungu. Ametakasika Yule Aliyetutiishia hiki, na sisi hatukuwa na uwezo nacho, na hakika sisi ni wenye kurejea kwa Mola wetu Mlezi.
duas.english: Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, whereas we could not have done it by ourselves. And indeed, to our Lord we will return.
duas.reference: Surat Az-Zukhruf 43:13-14, Hisn al-Muslim #205, Abu Dawud 2602, Tirmidhi 3446
duas.virtue_sw: Hutoa shukrani na kumuweka msafiri katika hifadhi ya Mwenyezi Mungu katika safari nzima.
duas.virtue_en: Invokes gratitude and Allah's guardianship during journeys by car, plane or vessel.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Mwenye Deni na Shida ya Kifedha
duas.title_en: Relief from Debt and Financial Hardship
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummakfinee bihalaalika 'an haraamik, wa aghninee bifadhlika 'amman siwaak.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nitosheleze kwa vilivyo halali Vyako nisihitaji vilivyo haramu Vyako, na unitajirishe kwa fadhila Zako nisiwe na haja na yeyote asiyekuwa Wewe.
duas.english: O Allah, suffice me with what is lawful against what is unlawful, and enrich me by Your grace from all besides You.
duas.virtue_sw: Ali alisema: Hata kama ungedaiwa deni zito kama mlima Uhud, Mwenyezi Mungu atakukidhia ukisoma dua hii.
duas.virtue_en: Even if your debts were as heavy as Mount Uhud, Allah will facilitate settling them.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuondolewa Ugumu Katika Jambo Lolote
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ سَهْلَ إِلاَّ مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلاً، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلاً.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma laa sahla illaa maa ja'altahoo sahlaa, wa Anta taj'alul-hazna idhaa shi'ta sahlaa.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakuna jambo rahisi ila lile Ulilolifanya Wewe kuwa rahisi, na Wewe unalifanya jambo gumu kuwa jepesi Ukitaka.
duas.english: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy, and You make hardship easy if You will.
duas.virtue_sw: Inarahisisha mitihani, masomo, kazi ngumu na changamoto zote za maisha.
duas.virtue_en: Eases examinations, stressful tasks, and complicated life hurdles.

duas.title_sw: Dua Wakati wa Msiba na Huzuni Kubwa
duas.title_en: When Afflicted by Calamity or Loss
duas.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا.
duas.transliteration: Innaa lillaahi wa innaa ilayhi raaji'oon, Allaahumma'jurnee fee museebatee, wakhluf lee khayram-minhaa.
duas.swahili: Hakika sisi ni wa Mwenyezi Mungu, na hakika sisi Kwake tutarejea. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nilipe ujira katika msiba wangu huu, na unibadilishie kitu kilicho bora zaidi kuliko hiki nilichokipoteza.
duas.english: Indeed to Allah we belong and to Him we shall return. O Allah, reward me for my affliction and replace it with something better.
duas.virtue_sw: Muislamu anayeisoma dua hii wakati wa msiba hulipwa thawabu na kupewa mbadala ulio bora zaidi duniani na Akhera.
duas.virtue_en: Brings immediate divine solace and replaces the loss with something far better.

duas.title_en: Expiation of an Assembly or Gathering
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanakallaahumma wa bihamdika, ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illaa Anta, astaghfiruka wa atoobu ilayk.
duas.swahili: Umetakasika Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, na sifa zote njema ni Zako. Ninashuhudia ya kwamba hapana mungu apasaye kuabudiwa kwa haki ila Wewe. Ninakuomba msamaha na ninatubu Kwako.
duas.english: Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise. I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
duas.virtue_sw: Hufuta makosa, maneno yasiyo na maana, na kuteleza kote kulikotokea ndani ya kikao, mazungumzo au mkutano kabla ya kutawanyika.
duas.virtue_en: Expiates any careless talk or sins that took place during a meeting or gathering.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالأَمْنِ وَالإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلاَمَةِ وَالإِسْلاَمِ، رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahu Akbar, Allaahumma ahillahoo 'alaynaa bil-amni wal-eemaan, was-salaamati wal-Islaam, Rabbee wa Rabbukallaah.
duas.swahili: Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mkubwa. Ewe Mola wetu, utuchomozee mwezi huu ukiwa na amani, imani, salama na Uislamu. Mola wangu na Mola wako ni Mwenyezi Mungu.
duas.english: Allah is the greatest. O Allah, let this moon appear on us with security and faith, with peace and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah.
duas.virtue_sw: Huweka mwezi mzima (k.m. mwezi wa Ramadhani au miezi mingine) katika baraka, utulivu na unyenyekevu kwa Muumba.
duas.virtue_en: Welcomes the new lunar month with prayers for peace, faith and righteousness.

duas.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ، وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ.
duas.transliteration: Dhahabadh-dhama'u, wabtallatil-'urooqu, wa thabatal-ajru in shaa' Allaah.
duas.swahili: Kiu kimeondoka, mishipa imelowa, na ujira umethibiti Mwenyezi Mungu Akitaka.
duas.english: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
duas.virtue_sw: Inasemwa pale tu unapofuturu; ni wakati ambao dua ya mfungaji haikataliwi.
duas.virtue_en: Recited right upon breaking the fast, a moment when supplication is accepted.

duas.title_sw: Dua Wakati wa Mngurumo wa Radi
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanal-ladhee yusabbihur-ra'du bihamdihee wal-malaa'ikatu min kheefatih.
duas.swahili: Ametakasika Yule ambaye radi inamtakasa kwa sifa Zake njema, na malaika wanamtakasa kwa kumkhofu Yeye.
duas.english: Glory be to Him whom thunder praises with praise, and the angels from the fear of Him.
duas.reference: Surat Ar-Ra'd 13:13, Hisn al-Muslim #168, Muwatta Malik 1801
duas.virtue_sw: Humkumbusha mja uwezo mkuu wa Allah mtukufu na humkinga na hofu wakati wa dhoruba.
duas.virtue_en: Reminds the believer of the supreme awe of Allah during violent thunderstorms.

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ.
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee ahyaanaa ba'da maa amaatanaa wa ilayhin-nushoor.
duas.swahili: Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu Aliyetufufua baada ya kutufisha (usingizini), na Kwake Yeye ndio marejeo ya ufufuo wote.
duas.english: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us and unto Him is the resurrection.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #1, Sahih al-Bukhari 6312, Sahih Muslim 2711
duas.virtue_sw: Muislamu anayeanza siku yake kwa kumshukuru Allah huwekewa ulinzi na baraka tele katika shughuli zote za siku.
duas.virtue_en: Beginning the morning by praising Allah infuses the entire day with barakah and divine grace.
